cases.name: a tier clip with a curve price past it goes

cases.note: the clip used less than 2000000, so it ends the points without joining them; 2000000 goes with nothing above it, and the clip then follows 1000000 and stands on 2000000, a tier price 1/1024 above it

cases.name: the probe above priced short of its ask backs nothing
cases.note: PRICED allows used 1 bp under the ask: 2001954 used 2001754, under 2000000 + (2000000 >> 10), so 2000000 goes. Backing compares used

cases.name: a tier price that falls under a curve point goes, and the points run past it
cases.note: P1 rules this fall out. It ends the points, so no point sits above the tier price and it goes; the points then run on the curve

cases.name: a tier third label goes, and the points run past it
